description: Read the app dashboard's setup checklist. Returns which tasks are complete and which are still open (privacy_policy, app_access, ads, content_rating, target_audience, store_settings, store_listings, prod_countries, prod_release, ...). WARNING: the `incomplete` list is NOT a list of blockers — measured live, it listed 10 open tasks while Play Console's own Submit button was enabled and the app then submitted fine. It mixes real setup items with the action you are trying to take (*_sent_for_review), paths the app does not use (open_*, prereg_*) and consequences that only become true after review and rollout (prod_rollout, serving_in_prod). Still far better than get_pre_submit_status, which reads declarations and listing warnings only. For whether a submission can actually go through, use send_app_for_review's dry run (Play's `blocked` flag) or the Publishing overview. Read-only.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

name: get_setup_state
